scope_completed_this_batch: Derivation of M1 / M2 / M3 from the consolidated MFI balance sheet – exact passages from the February 2024 Manual on MFI balance sheet statistics (Chapter 7 compilation sections) + supporting ECB Data Portal methodology statements
obj.notes: Priority item 6 from G.08 remaining list. Strengthens the MFI BSI → monetary aggregates soft connection already flagged. National contributions enter via item-by-item aggregation of NCB and other-MFI national balance sheets before consolidation. Central-government / POGI short-term deposit liabilities of a monetary character are added. No second NSI or municipal material opened.

scope_completed_this_batch: Guideline (EU) 2021/830 (ECB/2021/11) – full operative rules on NCB reporting of MFI balance-sheet items and interest-rate statistics to the ECB: subject matter, transmission deadlines, aggregation / grossing-up rules, treatment for monetary aggregates, and explicit cross-references to Regulation (EU) 2021/379 (ECB/2021/2)
obj.notes: Priority item 7 from G.08 remaining list. Completes the micro-items on transmission deadlines, aggregation rules and national contributions left open in the Finances strand. Complements the February 2024 Manual extraction (which cites this Guideline). No second NSI or municipal material opened. Older Guideline ECB/2014/15 is repealed by related acts and is not re-extracted.

scope_completed_this_batch: ECB / Eurosystem monetary policy operations – tools (open market operations, standing facilities, minimum reserve requirements) under Guideline (EU) 2015/510 (ECB/2014/60) as consolidated, official ECB descriptions of OMOs/MROs/LTROs, and cross-reference to Regulation (EU) 2021/378 (ECB/2021/1) on minimum reserves
obj.notes: User-requested exploration. Directly links to previously extracted Eurosystem balance-sheet items (lending related to monetary policy operations, deposit facility, current accounts covering minimum reserves) and MFI BSI statistics. Collateral rules now sit in a separate Guideline (EU) 2024/3129 and are not opened here. No second NSI or municipal material.

scope_completed_this_batch: ECB / Eurosystem collateral rules – mobilisation and management under Guideline (EU) 2024/3129 (ECB/2024/22), including the Eurosystem Collateral Management System (ECMS), domestic/cross-border channels, and explicit cross-references to eligibility criteria remaining in Guideline (EU) 2015/510 (ECB/2014/60)
obj.notes: User-requested exploration. Completes the operational side of monetary-policy implementation (tools extracted previously). Eligibility criteria and risk-control measures (haircuts, valuation) remain primarily in Guideline 2015/510 and related acts (e.g. haircut Guideline 2016/65); this Guideline governs mobilisation/management via the single ECMS platform. Later 2026 amending acts exist but the core 2024 text is the standing framework. No second NSI or municipal material opened.

scope_completed_this_batch: ECB / Eurosystem valuation haircut framework – Guideline (EU) 2016/65 (ECB/2015/35) on the valuation haircuts applied in the implementation of the Eurosystem monetary policy framework (consolidated), including haircut categories, levels for marketable and non-marketable assets, additional markdowns, and cross-references to Guideline (EU) 2015/510
obj.notes: User-requested investigation. Completes the risk-control layer of the collateral framework (mobilisation/management already extracted under Guideline 2024/3129; eligibility under Guideline 2015/510). Haircut levels are set in the Annex tables and are frequently amended; the operative structure (categories, factors determining the haircut, additional markdowns) is stable. Climate factors appear in later amendments to the monetary-policy Guideline but are not opened here. No second NSI or municipal material.

scope_completed_this_batch: ECB / Eurosystem open market operations overview – categories (MROs, LTROs, fine-tuning, structural), instruments, purpose and high-level characteristics under Guideline (EU) 2015/510 (ECB/2014/60) Title I, supplemented by the ECB official description
obj.notes: User-requested investigation of the market-operations overview. Completes the high-level architecture of the monetary-policy tools strand (detailed operational rules for collateral, haircuts and variation margins already extracted). No second NSI or municipal material opened.
